definitions.explanation: signature song; representative piece; best-known work (of a musician or composer)

examples.english: She has many hit songs, but her signature piece is surely her debut release.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{代表|だいひょう}→代表：03419_daihyou⟧ (representative) and ⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧ (piece of music). Refers to the single most recognized or iconic work of a musician, band, or composer.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {代表曲|だいひょうきょく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}えば→言う：00515_iu⟧: speaking of signature songs
- {代表曲|だいひょうきょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歌|うた}う→歌う：00684_utau⟧: to sing one's signature song
- {代表曲|だいひょうきょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{演奏|えんそう}する→演奏する：20349_ensousuru⟧: to perform one's signature piece

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ヒット{曲|きょく}→ヒット曲：25764_hittokyoku⟧: hit song — a commercially successful song, but not necessarily the most representative one
- ⟦{名曲|めいきょく}→名曲：17476_meikyoku⟧: masterpiece, classic — a renowned piece of music regardless of who composed it
- ⟦{代表作|だいひょうさく}→代表作：09952_daihyousaku⟧: representative work — the broader equivalent covering literature, film, art, etc., not just music
